review_scope: Independent read-only review of official-source GO and eight actual v4 previews; not a mesh, slicing or physical-print certificate.
result: No major source-GO blocker identified in final eight previews.
source_go_checks: Three above-ground levels, connected rectangular and diagonally oriented wings are preserved.
Both rectangular and diagonal terrace groups remain open above the decks; the outer floor silhouette has not been extruded into fully enclosed rooms.
The 2F rectangular terrace extends farther out than the 3F terrace and retains the stepped perimeter.
The 3F diagonal enclosed strip retreats to the traced room/terrace boundary around (1150,610)-(1310,743), leaving an open end terrace around the glass tower.
The higher glass corner mass remains at the traced diamond junction. Flat roofs and representative parapets remain visible.
The local 2.4 mm diagonal rail-joint reinforcement does not create a new room, rear wing or blocked terrace.

Omissions are consistent with scope: 1F additional upper-right hall/courtyard connection, detached toilet block, basement interiors, fine terrain/retaining walls, equipment and unverified fine rear details.
